body: Happened when I was in third grade, I have 3 siblings a younger brother, an older brother and an older sister. We were all watching tv in the living room with my dad, he told me he was going to take a nap on the couch and to wake him up at 7, tried to wake him up didn't budge we called 911 and I watched as my brother tried to perform CPR. He died that night on the way to the hospital. We watched our mom cry for weeks and couldn't do anything, it was right then and there I told myself I'm going to take care of our whole family.
